ayahs.1: Saad! Is naseehat wale Quran ki qasam.
ayahs.2: Balke kuffar ghuroor-o-mukhalifat mein pade hue hain.
ayahs.3: Hum ne un se pehle bhi bahut si ummaton ko tabaah kar daala, unhon ne har chand cheekh-o-pukaar ki lekin woh waqt chhutkaare ka na tha.
ayahs.4: Aur kaafiron ko is baat par taajjub hua ke un hi mein se ek unhein daraane wala aa gaya aur kehne lage ke yeh to jaadugar aur jhootha hai.
ayahs.5: Kya us ne itne saare maboodon ka ek hi mabood kar diya? Waqai yeh bahut hi ajeeb baat hai.
ayahs.6: Un ke sardaar yeh kehte hue chale ke chalo ji aur apne maboodon par jame raho, yaqeenan is baat mein to koi gharaz hai.
ayahs.7: Hum ne to yeh baat pichhle deen mein bhi nahin suni, kuchh nahin yeh to sirf ghadant hai.
ayahs.8: Kya hum sab mein se isi par kalam-e-Ilahi naazil kiya gaya hai? Darasal yeh log meri wahi ki taraf se shak mein hain, balke (saheeh yeh hai ke) unhon ne ab tak mera azaab chakha hi nahin.
ayahs.9: Ya kya un ke paas tere zabardast fayyaz Rabb ki rehmat ke khazane hain.
ayahs.10: Ya kya aasman-o-zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki har cheez ki baadshahat un hi ki hai, to phir yeh rassiyan taan kar chadh jaayen.
ayahs.11: Yeh bhi (bade bade) lashkaron mein se shikast paaya hua (chhota sa) lashkar hai.
ayahs.12: Un se pehle bhi qaum-e-Nooh aur Aad aur mekhon wale Firaun ne jhutlaaya tha.
ayahs.13: Aur Samood ne aur qaum-e-Loot ne aur Aika ke rehne walon ne bhi, yehi (bade) lashkar the.
ayahs.14: Un mein se ek bhi aisa na tha jis ne Rasoolon ki takzeeb na ki ho, pas meri saza un par saabit ho gayi.
ayahs.15: Unhein sirf ek cheekh ka intezaar hai jis mein koi tawaqquf (aur dheel) nahin hai.
ayahs.16: Aur unhon ne kaha ke ae hamare Rabb! Hamari sar-nawisht to hamein roz-e-hisaab se pehle hi de de.
ayahs.17: Aap un ki baaton par sabr karen aur hamare bande Daaood (alaihis salaam) ko yaad karen jo badi quwwat wala tha, yaqeenan woh bahut ruju karne wala tha.
ayahs.18: Hum ne pahaadon ko us ke taabe kar rakha tha ke us ke saath shaam ko aur subah ko tasbeeh-khwaani karen.
ayahs.19: Aur parindon ko bhi jama ho kar sab ke sab us ke zer-e-farmaan rehte.
ayahs.20: Aur hum ne us ki saltanat ko mazboot kar diya tha aur use hikmat di thi aur baat ka faisla karna.
ayahs.21: Aur kya tujhe jhagda karne walon ki (bhi) khabar mili? Jabke woh deewar phaand kar mehrab mein aa gaye.
ayahs.22: Jab yeh (Hazrat) Daaood (alaihis salaam) ke paas pahunche, pas yeh un se dar gaye, unhon ne kaha khauf na kijiye! Hum do fareeq-e-muqaddama hain, hum mein se ek ne doosre par ziyadati ki hai, pas aap hamare darmiyaan haq ke saath faisla kar dijiye aur na-insaafi na kijiye aur hamein seedhi raah bata dijiye.
ayahs.23: (Suniye) yeh mera bhai hai, is ke paas ninnanway dunbiyaan hain aur mere paas ek hi dunbi hai, lekin yeh mujh se keh raha hai ke apni yeh ek bhi mujh hi ko de de aur mujh par baat mein badi sakhti bartata hai.
ayahs.24: Aap ne farmaaya! Is ka apni dunbiyon ke saath teri ek dunbi mila lene ka sawaal be-shak tere upar ek zulm hai aur aksar hissedaar aur shareek (aise hi hote hain ke) ek doosre par zulm karte hain, siwaaye un ke jo imaan laaye aur jinhon ne nek amal kiye aur aise log bahut hi kam hain. Aur (Hazrat) Daaood (alaihis salaam) samajh gaye ke hum ne unhein aazmaaya hai, phir to apne Rabb se istighfar karne lage aur aajizi karte hue gir pade aur (poori tarah) ruju kiya.
ayahs.25: Pas hum ne bhi un ka woh (qusoor) maaf kar diya, yaqeenan woh hamare nazdeek bade martaba wale aur bahut achchhe thikaane wale hain.
ayahs.26: Ae Daaood! Hum ne tumhein zameen mein khaleefa bana diya, tum logon ke darmiyaan haq ke saath faisle karo aur apni nafsaani khwahish ki pairawi na karo warna woh tumhein Allah ki raah se bhatka degi. Yaqeenan jo log Allah ki raah se bhatak jaate hain un ke liye sakht azaab hai is liye ke unhon ne hisaab ke din ko bhula diya hai.
ayahs.27: Aur hum ne aasman-o-zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki cheezon ko na-haq paida nahin kiya, yeh gumaan to kaafiron ka hai, so kaafiron ke liye kharabi hai aag ki.
ayahs.28: Kya hum un logon ko jo imaan laaye aur nek amal kiye un ke baraabar kar denge jo (hamesha) zameen mein fasaad machaate rahe, ya parhezgaron ko badkaron jaisa kar denge?
ayahs.29: Yeh ba-barkat kitaab hai jise hum ne aap ki taraf is liye naazil farmaaya hai ke log is ki aayaton par ghaur-o-fikr karen aur aqalmand is se naseehat haasil karen.
ayahs.30: Aur hum ne Daaood ko Sulaiman (naami farzand) ata farmaaya, jo bada achchha banda tha aur be-had ruju karne wala tha.
ayahs.31: Jab un ke saamne shaam ke waqt tez-rau khaase ghode pesh kiye gaye.
ayahs.32: To kehne lage main ne apne Parwardigaar ki yaad par in ghodon ki mohabbat ko tarjeeh di, yahan tak ke (aaftab) chhup gaya.
ayahs.33: In (ghodon) ko dobara mere saamne laao! Phir to pindliyon aur gardanon par haath pherna shuru kar diya.
ayahs.34: Aur hum ne Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ki aazmaish ki aur un ke takht par ek jism daal diya, phir us ne ruju kiya.
ayahs.35: Kaha ke ae mere Rabb! Mujhe bakhsh de aur mujhe aisa mulk ata farma jo mere siwa kisi (shakhs) ke laaiq na ho, tu bada hi dene wala hai.
ayahs.36: Pas hum ne hawa ko un ke maatihati kar diya aur aap ke hukm se jahan aap chaahte narmi se pahuncha diya karti thi.
ayahs.37: Aur (taqatwar) jinnat ko bhi (un ka maatihati kar diya), har imaarat banaane wale ko aur ghota-khor ko.
ayahs.38: Aur doosre jinnat ko bhi jo zanjeeron mein jakde rehte.
ayahs.39: Yeh hai hamara atiya, ab tu ehsaan kar ya rok rakh, kuchh hisaab nahin.
ayahs.40: Un ke liye hamare paas bada taqarrub hai aur bahut achchha thikaana hai.
ayahs.41: Aur hamare bande Ayyub (alaihis salaam) ka (bhi) zikr kar, jabke us ne apne Rabb ko pukaara ke mujhe shaitaan ne ranj aur dukh pahunchaaya hai.
ayahs.42: Apna paaon maaro, yeh nahaane ka thanda aur peene ka paani hai.
ayahs.43: Aur hum ne use us ka poora kunba ata farmaaya balke itna hi aur bhi isi ke saath apni (khaas) rehmat se, aur aqalmandon ki naseehat ke liye.
ayahs.44: Aur apne haathon mein tinkon ka ek muttha (jhaadu) le kar maar de aur qasam ke khilaaf na kar. Sach to yeh hai ke hum ne use bada saabir banda paaya, woh bada nek banda tha aur badi hi raghbat rakhne wala.
ayahs.45: Hamare bandon Ibraheem, Ishaq aur Yaqoob (alaihimus salaam) ka bhi logon se zikr karo jo haathon aur aankhon wale the.
ayahs.46: Hum ne unhein ek khaas baat yaani aakhirat ki yaad ke saath makhsoos kar diya tha.
ayahs.47: Yeh sab hamare nazdeek barguzeeda aur behtareen log the.
ayahs.48: Ismail, Yasa aur Zul-Kifl (alaihimus salaam) ka bhi zikr kar dijiye. Yeh sab behtareen log the.
ayahs.49: Yeh naseehat hai aur yaqeen maano ke parhezgaron ki badi achchhi jagah hai.
ayahs.50: (Yaani hameshgi wali) jannatein jin ke darwaaze un ke liye khule hue hain.
ayahs.51: Jin mein ba-faraaghat takiye lagaaye baithe hue tarah tarah ke meway aur qism qism ki sharabon ki farmaishen kar rahe hain.
ayahs.52: Aur un ke paas neechi nazron wali hum-umar hooren hongi.
ayahs.53: Yeh hai jis ka waada tum se hisaab ke din ke liye kiya jaata tha.
ayahs.54: Be-shak roziyan (khaas) hamara atiya hain jin ka kabhi khaatma hi nahin.
ayahs.55: Yeh to hui jaza, (yaad rakho ke) sarkashon ke liye badi buri jagah hai.
ayahs.56: Dozakh hai jis mein woh jaayenge, (aah) kya hi bura bichhauna hai.
ayahs.57: Yeh hai, pas ise chakhein, garam paani aur peep.
ayahs.58: Is ke alaawa aur tarah tarah ke azaab.
ayahs.59: Yeh ek qaum hai jo tumhare saath (aag mein) jaane wali hai, koi khush-aamdeed un ke liye nahin hai, yehi to jahannam mein jaane wale hain.
ayahs.60: Woh kahenge balke tum hi ho jin ke liye koi khush-aamdeed nahin hai, tum hi ne to ise pehle hi se hamare saamne la rakha tha, pas rehne ki badi buri jagah hai.
ayahs.61: Woh kahenge ae hamare Rabb! Jis ne (kufr ki rasm) hamare liye pehle se nikaali ho us ke haq mein jahannam ki dugni saza kar de.
ayahs.62: Aur jahannami kahenge kya baat hai ke woh log hamein dikhaai nahin dete jinhein hum bure logon mein shumaar karte the.
ayahs.63: Kya hum ne hi un ka mazaaq bana rakha tha ya hamari nigaahein un se hat gayi hain.
ayahs.64: Yaqeen jaano ke dozakhiyon ka yeh jhagda zaroor hi hoga.
ayahs.65: Keh dijiye! Ke main to sirf khabardaar karne wala hoon aur bajuz Allah Waahid Ghaalib ke aur koi laaiq-e-ibaadat nahin.
ayahs.66: Jo Parwardigaar hai aasmanon ka aur zameen ka aur jo kuchh un ke darmiyaan hai, woh zabardast aur bada bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.67: Aap keh dijiye ke yeh bahut badi khabar hai.
ayahs.68: Jis se tum be-parwah ho rahe ho.
ayahs.69: Mujhe un buland-qadr farishton ki (baat-cheet ka) koi ilm hi nahin jabke woh takraar kar rahe the.
ayahs.70: Meri taraf faqat yehi wahi ki jaati hai ke main to saaf saaf aagaah kar dene wala hoon.
ayahs.71: Jabke aap ke Rabb ne farishton se irshaad farmaaya ke main mitti se insaan ko paida karne wala hoon.
ayahs.72: So jab main ise theek thaak kar loon aur is mein apni rooh phoonk doon, to tum sab is ke saamne sajde mein gir padna.
ayahs.73: Chunanche tamaam farishton ne sajda kiya.
ayahs.74: Magar Iblees ne (na kiya), us ne takabbur kiya aur woh tha kaafiron mein se.
ayahs.75: (Allah Taala ne) farmaaya ae Iblees! Tujhe ise sajda karne se kis cheez ne roka jise main ne apne haathon se paida kiya. Kya tu kuchh ghamand mein aa gaya hai? Ya tu bade darje walon mein se hai.
ayahs.76: Us ne jawab diya ke main is se behtar hoon, tu ne mujhe aag se banaaya, aur ise mitti se banaaya hai.
ayahs.77: Irshaad hua ke tu yahan se nikal ja, tu mardood hua.
ayahs.78: Aur tujh par qayamat ke din tak meri laanat-o-phitkaar hai.
ayahs.79: Kehne laga mere Rabb mujhe logon ke uth khade hone ke din tak mohlat de.
ayahs.80: (Allah Taala ne) farmaaya tu mohlat walon mein se hai.
ayahs.82: Kehne laga phir to teri izzat ki qasam! Main in sab ko yaqeenan behka doonga.
ayahs.83: Bajuz tere un bandon ke jo cheeda aur pasandeeda hon.
ayahs.84: Farmaaya sach to yeh hai, aur main sach hi kaha karta hoon.
ayahs.85: Ke tujh se aur tere tamaam maanne walon se main (bhi) jahannam ko bhar doonga.
ayahs.86: Keh dijiye ke main tum se is par koi badla talab nahin karta aur na main takalluf karne walon mein se hoon.
ayahs.87: Yeh to tamaam jahaan walon ke liye sarasar naseehat (o-ibrat) hai.
ayahs.88: Yaqeenan tum is ki haqeeqat ko kuchh hi waqt ke baad (saheeh taur par) jaan loge.
